title: Windows pipe frame envelope
description: One frame sent to the Enitor named pipe (formats.md, section 2, Transports). The frame is 4-byte little-endian length + UTF-8 JSON, at most 64 KB; the reply is one JSON text. source is cli or mcp; Enitor treats any other value as cli.

oneOf.title: permissions
oneOf.description: Asks which permissions the source has. Used by MCP to list only the allowed tools.

oneOf.title: command
oneOf.description: A command request, the same as the JSON in command.schema.json.

source.description: Who sends the request. Missing or any other value means cli.

request.description: A command request. Its full rules are in command.schema.json; they are checked by the formats examples test, not by this schema.

oneOf.title: link
oneOf.description: Opens an enitor:// link through the usual confirmation form.

url.description: An enitor:// link, see section 1 of formats.md.
